user_intention: USER-dbf42ea3/USER-02bf4ed1: measure frozen pre/post train error and game-heldout batch effect; training loss reduction alone is not proof of overfitting.
source_policy: Protected original B170 full model/upper+lower Adam/RNG/240 environments per rank; source remains unchanged. If exact170 boundary missed, revise before diagnostic collection.

interpretation.fixed: All arms restore identical source weights/moments/RNG and same natural cohort; critic LR.0001, actorLR.00012/2epochs, micro256, MC labels, GAE.97 and search unchanged. Train720 whole games, holdout240; report exact decision denominators. Shared batch changes actor updates too, but actor/critic have disjoint networks and optimizers and critic fits fixed MC labels: critic batch contrast is independent of actor parameters; this is not an actor-only or frozen-actor online comparison.
interpretation.epoch_curve: Each epoch1/2/4 arm starts at same source; same batch-specific critic permutation prefix. Compare equal epochs within batch pairs; report actual ceil(N/batch) Adam, not call lower train loss better generalization.
interpretation.full_vs_probe: Full train/holdout MSE evaluated on all decisions with float32 MC labels and float64 SSE. Categorical KL and bootstrap diagnostics use fixed at most4096 decisions per split/rank; these are separately labeled sampled probes.
interpretation.selection: No automatic online adoption from this single-cohort diagnostic. Train MSE down plus holdout MSE up is evidence consistent with within-cohort overfitting, not proof of long-run win-rate causality; one split/one checkpoint cannot establish stable superiority. Report every arm and repeat tolerances, not select best probe score as independent test performance.
interpretation.cost: Two full-critic evaluation passes and all probe/update costs included in diagnostic end-to-end/resource accounting. No production420s comparison against this1200s diagnostic. Timeout/nonfinite/restore failure is failure, no automatic retry.
